project.scope: front doors with pin tumbler cylinder locks, common in North America and Europe in the 2020s (other lock types exist)
project.futureWay: on Lumen, doors recognize the person who arrives, so nobody carries a key
project.insight: a house key was a password cut into metal that people carried with them
project.tone: curious, warm and lightly funny; never mocking ordinary people

relicDescription: a small flat brass house key (#D4A64A, thick black outline): a round bow with a white hole and a straight blade with five jagged cuts along one edge; dusty and scuffed; a little longer than Kip's head is wide; in Kip's RIGHT hand unless a clip says otherwise

cast.name: Sam
cast.role: a generic present-day homeowner (not a real person) who shows Kip how a key opens a front door
cast.headShape: a perfect white circle with a thick black outline
cast.proportions: same stick proportions as Kip, about 10 percent smaller; thin straight stick arms and legs; small round fingerless hands
cast.face: two black dot eyes, short expressive eyebrows, a single-line mouth; no nose, no ears
cast.hairOrHeadwear: Short dark-brown hair cap with a small round bun at the back of the head
cast.clothing: a plain terracotta trapezoid t-shirt from shoulders to hips, no logos
cast.signatureProp: A small steel keyring with three brass house keys, carried in the RIGHT hand
cast.distinguishing: the hair bun; never a halo, a tunic or a Chrono-Band
immutable: round white head with dot eyes
no future gear of any kind
changeable: which key from the ring is in use (record it per clip)

clips.purpose: Hook: Kip finds the relic in his future world and cannot explain it
clips.location: the edge of a Lumen city plaza beside an excavation into the Old Layers (buried ruins)
clips.framing: medium-wide, eye level, Kip slightly right of center, ground line at 55 percent of the frame height

layout.foreground: lower left: a ground cutaway with four blue-gray soil layers, a dashed key-shaped imprint in the deepest one, and two posts with a glowing cyan rope
layout.middleground: Kip on the ground line just right of the dig site; open space at the right
layout.background: rounded white towers with thin cyan and violet light lines and two floating platforms

characters.position: slightly right of center, feet on the ground line
characters.pose: right arm raised high, holding the key up to study it
characters.holding: the relic key in his RIGHT hand, cuts facing down, glowing softly

characters.position: two plain Lumen citizens, outside the frame at the right

clips.opening: Kip has just lifted the dusty relic key out of the dig site and holds it up into the light; a soft golden glow surrounds it.
beats: Hold on Kip studying the glowing key; small golden sparkles circle it and he tilts his head.

A round magnifier circle pops up beside the key and shows its five jagged cuts in close-up, then shrinks away; a dashed golden line traces from the key down to the key-shaped imprint in the deepest soil layer, which glows.
Two plain Lumen citizens in pale-gray tunics walk in from the right, stop beside Kip and look at the key.
Both citizens shrug; Kip lowers the key to chest height and shrugs too, looking worried; hold for half a second.
clips.camera: static frame with a very slow push-in of about 4 percent over the whole clip
clips.finalState: Kip slightly right of center facing right, shrugging and worried, the key in his RIGHT hand at chest height; the two citizens at the right, facing left, shrugging; the dig site imprint glowing at the lower left.
clips.transition: intentional cut to clip C02: the same future city, Kip calm and about to tap his Chrono-Band

sfx: soft sparkle chime when the magnifier pops up
light footsteps for the citizens
a small questioning synth note on the shrug
sound.music: start the future bed quietly from the first frame

avoid: no readable marks or writing on the soil or on the key

outgoing.positions: Kip slightly right of center; two citizens at the right edge
outgoing.direction: Kip faces right, the citizens face left; nobody is moving

clips.purpose: He travels back with the Chrono-Band and arrives in the present day
clips.location: a Lumen city plaza, then an ordinary present-day residential street with three simple houses, a lamp post and a round tree
clips.framing: medium-wide, eye level, Kip left of center, ground line at 62 percent of the frame height; same framing after the jump

layout.foreground: an empty smooth pale plaza floor
layout.middleground: Kip left of center; empty space at the right where the portal will open
layout.background: rounded white towers with cyan and violet light lines

characters.position: left of center, feet on the ground line
characters.pose: standing relaxed, right hand starting to move toward his LEFT wrist
characters.holding: the relic key in his RIGHT hand

characters.position: not in the starting frame; appears in the present-day street at the right edge
characters.facing: left, toward the door of the house on the right

clips.opening: Kip stands calmly in the plaza, about to tap the violet Chrono-Band on his LEFT wrist.
beats: Kip taps the violet Chrono-Band on his LEFT wrist with his right hand, still holding the key; the band pulses violet.
A ring portal of concentric cyan and violet circles opens to his right; Kip walks into it, shrinking slightly as he passes through; the portal collapses into a bright dot with a soft white flash.
The flash reveals a warm present-day street; a shrinking violet ring drops Kip off at the left with a soft flash; he looks around, amazed.
Sam walks in from the right toward the door of the house on the right; Kip points at Sam with his right hand, the key still in it; hold.
clips.camera: static; one clean switch at about 5 seconds from the future plaza to the present street, keeping the same framing
clips.finalState: Present-day street: Kip left of center facing right, pointing with his right hand that still holds the key, curious; Sam near the house on the right, facing left.
clips.transition: intentional cut to clip C03: a closer view of a present-day front door that Sam walks up to

sfx: a violet chime pulse on the wrist tap
the time-travel shimmer whoosh as the portal opens
a bright pop when the portal collapses
street ambience fading in on arrival
sound.music: the future bed crossfades into the present bed at the arrival

avoid: no cars or real brands on the street

outgoing.positions: Kip left of center; Sam at the right in front of a house
outgoing.direction: Kip faces right; Sam faces left, slowing to a stop
outgoing.changes: Kip is now in the present day (the 2020s)

clips.purpose: He watches how people open a door with a key today
clips.location: a simple present-day doorstep: warm plaster wall with thin siding lines and a brown wooden front door on the right, lock on the door's left edge
clips.framing: medium shot at eye level, the door filling the right third, ground line at about 62 percent of the frame height

layout.foreground: a light doormat strip in front of the door
layout.middleground: Kip at the left watching; Sam walking toward the door from the center
layout.background: the closed brown front door with two recessed panels, a brass knob and a brass lock below it

characters.position: left third, feet on the ground line
characters.facing: right, toward Sam and the door
characters.pose: standing, key held at waist height
characters.holding: the relic key in his RIGHT hand

characters.position: center-left, two steps away from the door
characters.holding: the keyring with three keys in the RIGHT hand

clips.opening: Sam is walking up to the closed front door with a swinging keyring while Kip watches from the left.
beats: Sam takes two steps and stops in front of the door; the keyring swings.
Sam lifts the keyring to chest height and jingles it; Kip lifts his own key to compare, curious; Sam pushes one key into the lock.
Sam twists the wrist and the key's bow turns a quarter turn in the lock with a small click; Kip leans in, thinking, hand near his chin.
The door swings inward on its right-side hinges, revealing the dark interior; Sam relaxes, happy; Kip throws his arms up in surprise; hold.
clips.finalState: Door open inward; Sam at the door facing right, happy, the keyring hanging from the key in the lock; Kip at the left with arms up in surprise, the key in his RIGHT hand, delighted.
clips.transition: intentional transition into clip C04: a circular zoom into the lock on the door's left edge

sfx: keys jingling
a key sliding into the lock
a metallic click on the twist
a soft door swing

avoid: no house number or name plate
the door opens inward, not outward

outgoing.positions: Kip at the left; Sam at the door, right of center
outgoing.propOwner: Kip holds the relic; Sam's keyring hangs from the key in the lock
outgoing.propHand: Kip: RIGHT hand; Sam: keys left in the lock

clips.purpose: The explanation of how the pin tumbler lock really works
clips.location: a side cutaway diagram of that front door's lock
clips.framing: flat side cutaway, straight on; the housing fills the upper middle of the frame

layout.foreground: a round front-view inset at the lower right showing the cylinder face, its keyway slot and a steel bolt
layout.middleground: the cutaway: beige housing; a gold cylinder (plug) under a dashed yellow shear line; five holes, each with a gray spring, a steel-gray driver pin and a brass key pin of a different length; the driver pins cross the line
layout.background: a warm off-white card with a thin tan border

characters.position: lower left corner, small (about one third of the diagram's height)
characters.pose: explaining, right arm raised toward the diagram
characters.holding: the relic key in his RIGHT hand

clips.opening: Locked, no key: springs push the five pin stacks down, so the steel driver pins cross the dashed shear line and block the gold cylinder.
beats: Hold on the locked diagram; the five springs pulse with a soft yellow ring; in the lower-right inset the cylinder tries to turn, shakes, and a red X appears.
A brass key slides in from the left into the cylinder; as its jagged edge passes underneath, the pin stacks bob up and down.
The key reaches the end: every gap between a driver pin and a key pin lines up exactly on the dashed shear line, which brightens, and all key pins turn green.
In the inset the cylinder rotates a quarter turn and the steel bolt slides back; Kip throws both arms up, happy; hold.
clips.camera: static diagram; only the parts move
clips.motionLimits: mechanical motion only: the key slides horizontally, pins move only vertically, springs compress and stretch; proportions never change
clips.finalState: Key fully in, all five pin gaps on the shear line, key pins green; inset cylinder turned 90 degrees, bolt retracted; Kip at the lower left, arms up, key in his RIGHT hand.
clips.transition: intentional cut to clip C05: a split screen with the same lock seen small inside a round lens on the top half

sfx: a soft spring boing
a metal slide as the key enters
a bright ding when the pins align
a solid click as the bolt retracts
sound.music: present bed, slightly lower under the explanation

avoid: labels are added in the editor

outgoing.positions: Kip at the lower left; diagram in the center
outgoing.propOwner: Kip holds his relic; the diagram key stays in the lock

clips.purpose: The direct comparison between our way and his way
clips.location: top half: the same present-day doorstep, smaller; bottom half: an entrance in Lumen with a rounded white arch door
clips.framing: vertical split screen, a thick black horizontal divider slightly above the middle; both halves wide at eye level

layout.foreground: top: a round lens at the upper left showing the small lock cutaway; bottom: a smooth pale plaza floor
layout.middleground: top: Sam at the door, key in the lock; bottom: Kip at the left, a rounded white arch door with a cyan scan ring at the right
layout.background: top: warm wall with siding lines; bottom: rounded white towers with cyan and violet light lines

characters.position: right of center in the top half, at the door
characters.holding: a WRONG key from the keyring, inserted in the lock with the RIGHT hand

characters.position: left side of the bottom half, feet on its ground line
characters.holding: the relic key in his RIGHT hand

clips.opening: Top: Sam's wrong key is going into the lock, seen in the lens. Bottom: Kip in his own time, about to walk to his door; the bottom half is dimmed.
beats: Top: in the lens the wrong key slides in, one pin stops off the dashed line and turns red; Sam jiggles the key, worried. The bottom half stays dim and still.
The bottom half brightens: Kip walks to the arch door, the cyan ring scans him and the door slides up by itself; Kip raises both arms, happy.
Top: Sam pulls the wrong key out and inserts the right one; in the lens all pins line up green on the dashed line.
Top: the key turns and the front door swings open; both halves now show an open door; hold.
clips.camera: static split screen, no camera move
clips.finalState: Top: front door open, Sam happy at the door. Bottom: arch door open, Kip happy in front of it with the key in his RIGHT hand.
clips.transition: intentional cut to clip C06: Kip arrives back home in the Lumen museum through a shrinking violet ring

sfx: a dull clunk for the blocked key
a soft scan chime for the Lumen door
a key click and a door swing on the top half
sound.music: alternate the present bed (top) and the future bed (bottom) with a soft crossfade

avoid: keep the divider line straight and clean

outgoing.positions: Kip center-right in the bottom half; Sam at the door in the top half
outgoing.propOwner: Kip holds the relic; Sam's key is in the lock

clips.purpose: He returns home and the video lands its insight
clips.location: a calm Lumen museum hall with two white display pedestals topped by faint glass domes
clips.framing: medium-wide shot at eye level, Kip just left of center, the right pedestal in the right third

layout.middleground: Kip just left of center; the right display pedestal with an empty glass dome
layout.background: a large rounded white wall panel, a faint second pedestal at the left, and empty air above Kip for a floating light panel

characters.position: just left of center, feet on the ground line
characters.holding: the relic key in his RIGHT hand

clips.opening: A shrinking violet ring with a soft flash has just dropped Kip off in the museum; he stands holding the relic key.
beats: Kip raises the key, which glows golden.
A floating cyan light panel appears above him showing the key's jagged edge as a zigzag line; five empty rounded tiles appear under the five cuts one by one.
Kip walks to the right pedestal and reaches out with his right hand to place the key inside the glass dome.
The key rests on the pedestal and glows warmly; Kip steps back and throws both arms up, happy; hold the final frame.
clips.camera: static with a very slow push-in of about 3 percent
clips.finalState: The key glowing on the right pedestal inside the dome; Kip right of center facing right, arms up, happy, hands empty; the light panel still floating above.
clips.transition: end of the episode: hold the last frame for one second

sfx: an arrival pop and soft flash
a glassy chime as each tile appears
a warm bell when the key is placed
sound.music: the future bed resolves on a soft final chord

avoid: the five tiles stay empty; the digits 3 5 2 4 4 are added in the editor

outgoing.positions: Kip right of center beside the right pedestal
outgoing.propOwner: the museum: the key rests on the pedestal
outgoing.changes: the relic now rests in the display case
